descriptor.retrieval_description: Cylindrical aluminum beverage can with a smooth, dry, coated metal sidewall and continuous curvature. The intended contact region is clean and uniform, presenting opposing lateral pads against a smooth cylindrical profile.
descriptor.contact_region: Opposing lateral sides of the cylindrical body, centered vertically
descriptor.local_geometry: Continuous cylindrical curvature with smooth lateral surface
descriptor.uncertainty: The lateral surface is partially obscured by top-down perspective, but the cylindrical geometry and coating are clearly discernible.
